# Japan Graduate Visa Check

> Free, unofficial date checklist for international students graduating in Japan. With a job offer: change from Student (留学) to a work status (usually 技術・人文知識・国際業務); for April starts the Immigration Services Agency (ISA) asks students to file between 1 December and 31 January (a request, not a legal deadline); other start dates: file once you have the offer, ideally 2+ months ahead (standard processing 1–2 months). You can file with a certificate of expected graduation and collect the new card after graduating; you cannot start work before the grant. Still job hunting: university / 専門士 graduates with a school recommendation can switch to 特定活動 (継続就職活動), 6 months + 1 renewal (~1 year). Long gap before the start date: 内定者 特定活動 (hire within 1 year of the offer and 1 year 6 months of graduation). Always: part-time work on the 留学 permission ends at graduation; report leaving the school to ISA within 14 days. Rules as of 2026-11-10. Educational, not advice; not affiliated with ISA or any school.

Site: https://japan-graduate-visa.vercel.app

## Key facts (official sources below)
- April starts (ISA 10_00240): file 12/1–1/31. If 留学 expires on or before 1/31 and you are still studying after that, extend 留学 first. Document omission since 2025-12-01 for Japanese-university graduates, top-300 foreign-university graduates, or employers already employing a former student (not dispatch).
- Change of status (ISA 16-2): from when the reason arises up to the current expiry; standard processing 1–2 months; fee by period granted from 2026-10-01 (counter ¥10,000–¥75,000, 1 year ¥33,000; online ¥10,000–¥65,000 + ¥330/¥550). A timely application keeps you lawfully in Japan until the decision, up to 2 months after expiry.
- 継続就職活動 特定活動 (nyukan_nyukan84): 6 months, renewable once; school recommendation; 2nd year only via eligible local-government programmes; foreign-bachelor graduates of certain certified Japanese language schools also eligible. 資格外活動 up to 28 h/week possible.
- 内定者 特定活動 (nyuukokukanri07_00013): Japanese university / vocational graduates; hired within 1 year of offer AND 1 year 6 months of graduation; employer pledge; 28 h/week possible.
- Part-time ends at graduation (school guidance, e.g. Meiji University). Staying long on 留学 after graduating is not allowed.
- 所属機関に関する届出: within 14 days of leaving the school.
- Not covered: whether your job fits 技人国 (ISA judges duties vs major), 46号 details (see Japan JLPT Level Check), J-Find, startup visas.

## API (free, no key, CORS open)

### GET
GET https://japan-graduate-visa.vercel.app/api/check?graduationDate=2027-03-20&jobStartDate=2027-04-01&studentExpiry=2027-07-15&plan=job_offer&today=2026-11-10
→ verdict "too_early", windowOpens "2026-12-01", recommendedBy "2027-01-31", lastDay "2027-03-31", partTimeEnds "2027-03-20", notifySchoolLeftBy "2027-04-03", fee.totalJPY 33000, deadlines, actions, warnings, sources, disclaimer

### POST
POST https://japan-graduate-visa.vercel.app/api/check
{"graduationDate":"2027-03-20","studentExpiry":"2027-07-15","plan":"job_hunting","today":"2027-03-25"}
→ verdict "open", jobHuntingUntil "2028-03-20", fee.totalJPY 18000

Parameters: graduationDate (required), plan (job_offer | job_hunting | leaving | further_study), jobStartDate (required for job_offer), studentExpiry, school (university | vocational | language_school | other), foreignBachelor, offerDate, appliedDate, expectedGrantMonths, method (counter | online), today. Aliases accepted (内定, 就職活動, 帰国, 専門学校, 卒業日, 入社日…).

Verdicts: too_early | open | urgent | applied | not_eligible | expired | info.

Bad input → 400 {error, docs, example, disclaimer}.
